proposition: Two of Melvin-Koushki's statements pull against each other on the date of the Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr: the commentary is dated to Dhū l-Ḥijja 806/1404, yet it is said to reference the Mafāḥiṣ (dated 823/1420) and the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam (finished 814/1411, and 813 in the timeline). The dissertation does not comment on the tension on these pages; possible explanations (later revision of the Persian version, a different completion date for the Arabic version) are not supplied by the text and are not asserted here.

mediation.who: R4 (researcher pass), noticing the tension between two MK statements
